notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Very small pill collapsed and a full timeline with ETA, carrier and number when open, with good ARIA, but dead space under the buttons and an odd wrapped Notify button.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Compact two-line collapsed toast with progress bar, clean open state with carrier, number, timeline and actions, though it lacks reduced-motion and dismiss is just Hide.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Richest tracking with segmented progress and a NOW marker, but the dismiss X collides with the chevron, the timeline is clipped mid-row, and the actions wrap awkwardly.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Tight, tidy and readable with a clear ETA and bar, but it ships expanded, has no reduced-motion handling, and its timeline gives little detail.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Rich content, but the chevron and close icons overlap in the header, the timeline is clipped mid-row with a dead gap below the buttons, and the opened card looks unfinished.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Tidy and very compact: collapsed it shows status and ETA with a progress bar, and opened it fits the number, steps and actions cleanly; it has no Escape handling or status role.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Clear status, ETA, carrier, copyable number, full timeline and actions, plus Escape and labeled controls; the collapsed chip is small, though the opened card is a little tall.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Well-built toggle with good accessibility and separate open and close easing, but the timeline shows a stray 'Expected · Expected' and the opened card is large with wasted space.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Clean teal dark toast with status, ETA, carrier, number and steps, but defaults open, no reduced-motion handling, and the collapsed pill is tidy but the open state lacks locations.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Very compact collapsed pill but the open state clips the timeline mid-row, the close icon overlaps the chevron, and leaves dead space below the buttons.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Rich tracking with carrier, number, ETA, locations and demo states, though the open card is tall with a wrapped action row and a duplicated 'Expected · Expected' glitch.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Compact collapsed toast with progress bar and arrival window opens to a complete, well-fitted timeline, tracking number with copy, and three clear actions with no layout glitches.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Slim pill that opens to a rich multi-package timeline with good ARIA, but the package tabs are clipped, the title wraps awkwardly and the actions wrap into a second row.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Polished icon toast with progress bar, five-step stepper, timeline, carrier and number, pager dots and labeled actions; clear chevron state, aria-expanded and live region, with a slightly clipped subtitle when open.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Pill is neat and has a T shortcut, but the open timeline is misaligned with right-aligned events and times stranded under dots, leaving dead space and weak hierarchy.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Clean, tidy toast with progress bar, ETA and timeline, but the UPS/USPS/FedEx tabs are confusing, the number is minimal and there is a bit of empty space at the bottom.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Nice small pill, but the opened timeline is misaligned (right-aligned text, orphaned times, dead space at bottom) and has no ETA in detail view.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Tidy compact toast with progress bar, clear timeline, ETA and carrier tabs, but little aria-live support and no reduced-motion handling.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Dense and polished with stepper, scan log, masked tracking number, alerts toggle and pager dots; subtitle truncates slightly when open.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Good collapsed pill with count badge, but the opened state has truncated carrier tabs, wrapped tracking number and an orphan Dismiss row.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clean collapsed card with progress bar and a tidy opened timeline, but a carrier tab row duplicates the number and the opened card has dead space at the bottom.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: The collapsed pill is the smallest, but the opened timeline is misaligned (right-aligned text, timestamps below, stray dots) and the package item is never named.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Rich multi-package tracking with the Now badge, ETA and actions, but it is the tallest, the tab labels are truncated and the tracking number wraps.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Compact card with a stepper, timestamped scans, a masked tracking number and labeled actions, polished with a green accent, though the collapsed subtitle truncates on mobile.
